direct_claims: This chart reports the number of states involved in state-based conflicts in 2024, broken out by world region plus a global total.
The listed values are Africa 17, Americas 2, Asia and Oceania 7, Europe 2, Middle East 6, and World 34.
The source link indicates the data is published through Our World in Data.
The accompanying domain note says the count includes states that were primary participants in at least one interstate, intrastate, or extrasystemic conflict ongoing in that year.
In conflict datasets, a count of states involved measures how many countries were participants, not how many separate wars or how many deaths occurred.

Because the domain note includes interstate, intrastate, and extrasystemic conflicts, a state can be counted for involvement in more than one type of conflict as long as it was a primary participant in at least one ongoing conflict that year.
The world total of 34 means 34 states were recorded as primary participants in ongoing state-based conflicts in 2024.
Since only one year is shown, this chart cannot by itself tell whether conflict participation is rising or falling over time.
The metadata does not provide axis labels, alt text, ARIA description, or the chart image itself.
The absence of a time series means any statement about increases, decreases, persistence, or acceleration would go beyond the provided evidence.
